create_evaluation_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with sacreBLEU tokenizer type 13a for evaluation-time text tokenization
tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence using the EvaluationTokenizer with optional lowercasing and punctuation removal
remove_punctuation_classmethod: remove punctuation from a sentence using the EvaluationTokenizer remove_punctuation class method based on Unicode category
create_character_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with character tokenization enabled to split text into individual characters
review_tokenizer_types: review the EvaluationTokenizer ALL_TOKENIZER_TYPES enum to see available sacreBLEU tokenizer options like none, 13a, intl, zh, ja-mecab
